scope: Launch the configured browser with a fresh temporary profile, complete the CDP setup handshake, then verify profile cleanup. The test does not navigate to an external source or make provider requests.

browsers.name: Google Chrome
browsers.detail: Chromium exited before CDP was ready (signal 6 / SIGABRT).

browsers.name: Chromium
browsers.detail: Chromium exited before CDP was ready (signal 6 / SIGABRT).

diagnostic: Direct headless startup with the same isolation/CDP arguments also terminated with shell status 134 and emitted no stderr, including with Chromium stderr logging enabled. Root cause is not established.

likely_cause.assessment: The command sandbox's macOS app-registration or Mach-bootstrap restriction is the leading explanation.
supporting_evidence: validation-results/release-checks.md records Chromium MachPort rendezvous denied with Permission denied (1100) before the first local HTTP request.
validation-results/live.json records the same default-sandbox denial and a successful localhost-only replay through managed review on 2026-09-21.
likely_cause.limitation: Those earlier Playwright observations do not prove that the current Rust test's SIGABRT has the same cause; no current crash report or OS log ties signal 6 to the denial.

remaining: Run the opt-in CDP startup/cleanup test outside the command sandbox or inspect its crash/OS log there, without weakening browser sandboxing or host controls.
Verify PH/Windy against authorized provider credentials and retained provider responses.
